name: Thread the Needle on the Carriage

load.note: Any light setting works — stay on whatever is already on if it feels supportive.

summary: On hands and knees with one hand on the footbar and the carriage free to glide, the other arm threads under the body as the chest turns, then opens to the ceiling.
steps: Kneel on the carriage, one hand on the footbar, knees under hips.
Breathe out to thread the free arm under the body, letting the carriage slide back and the shoulder lower.
Breathe in to come back and open the arm to the ceiling.

layers.title: Thread under
layers.text: Slide through and come back to square.

layers.title: Add the open
layers.text: Open the arm to the ceiling and follow it with the eyes.

layers.title: Hold the twist
layers.text: Two breaths threaded under with the carriage still.

cautions.note: Fist or forearm on the bar.

cues:
Hips stay over the knees.
Turn from the ribs.
Let the carriage glide; don't force it.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
